Bước 2: Vận tải Lưu Lê cử nhân viên xuốn.en: Step 2: Liu Transport sent staff down to the warehouse to survey reality. See the number, the type of goods to send and the address here. The price of the contract was then announced to send Saigon - KNN Ming close to reality.

KCN Quang Minh được đánh giá là có vị tr.en: KNN Ming is rated for geographical and traffic positions that are very convenient. From here to the center of Hanoi's capital is about 10 km (10 km), located just next to the major highways, including the Cabinet - Laos Cai. It is also very close to residential areas, public services.
KCN Quang Minh được đánh giá là có vị tr.zh: KNN明被评为地理和交通位置非常方便. 从这里到河内省会中心约10公里(10公里),地处包括内阁-老挝蔡等主要高速公路相邻. 它也非常接近住宅区,公共服务.

Khu công nghiệp Quang Minh có địa chỉ ở.en: The Light Ming Industrial Zone has an address in both the Town of Light and Chi East Towns, the district of Mellum, Hanoi. The area of KNNN Ming is 334ha, with this 100% fill-up rate of KNC attracts a lot of major investors in the country and abroad. With major industries such as manufacturing, precise mechanical equipment, car parts, motorcycles,... As of now, the Ming industry has more than 133 businesses that operate and create jobs for more than 38,000 workers.
Khu công nghiệp Quang Minh có địa chỉ ở.zh: 光明工业区有位于河内市梅勒姆区光明镇和济东镇的地址. KNNN明的面积为334ha,KNC的这一100%的填充率吸引了国内外许多主要投资者. 以制造业,精确机械设备,汽车零部件,摩托车等主要产业为主. 截至目前,明一行有企业133多家,为3.8万多工人经营并创造就业机会.

Nhờ sở hữu ưu điểm về vị trí và giao thô.en: As a result of the ownership of the position and traffic benefits, KNNN Ming became extremely active in trade. Individuals, businesses in the KNC Ming perform daily delivery. More than just sending goods, products to domestic and international areas. It's at KNN Ming that also very often receives supplies from other places. Examples of it are Saigon, with a variety of receivers such as electronic equipment, food, documents, vehicles,...
Nhờ sở hữu ưu điểm về vị trí và giao thô.zh: 由于地位所有权和交通利益,克能明在贸易上变得极为活跃. 个人,KNC明的商行每天进行送货. 不仅仅是把商品,产品送到国内和国际领域. 在克南明也经常收到来自其他地方的补给. 它的例子有西贡,拥有电子设备,食品,文件,车辆等多种接收器.

Trong khu công nghiệp Quang Minh có cơ s.en: In the Light Ming Industrial Area there is a comprehensive and modern infrastructure. With internal traffic consisting of 4 main lanes, 36 m long and two side lanes, 24 m long. The power source is fully supplied, with 60MVA capacity. Furthermore, the clean water system operates 1370m3/day, responding to effective businesses. In KNC there are also wastewater processing systems, Internet and communications, fire departments,... All are well-planned, making every operation in KNA Ming go smoothly.
Trong khu công nghiệp Quang Minh có cơ s.zh: 光明工业区有全面现代化的基础设施. 内部交通由4个正道组成,长36米,并设有2个侧道,长24米. 电源完全供给,拥有60个MVA容量. 此外,清洁水系统每天运作1370立方米,以适应有效的商业。 KNC也有废水处理系统,互联网和通信,消防部门,...... 这一切都是精心策划的,使KNA明的每一个行动都顺利进行.
